name: Invincible Vs.: Angstrom - Multitudes Skin
summary: I am Angstrom Levy and Invincible made me into a monster! I've walked through more realities than you could ever comprehend. Worlds where empires rose, worlds where they fell, worlds where your greatest heroes never existed... and worlds where they became monsters. Every step taught me something. Every dimension made me stronger. This? It's simply the attire befitting a man who has seen them all.
